messages:
maria (oncall-sre): Alert: spike of 502/gateway timeouts from hosted inference in eu-west2 ~13:42 UTC. Customers reporting retries + auth failures. Seeing increased upstream retransmits to Provider-X. Opening thread for triage.

devops-bot: Incident created: INC-5001 - eu-west2 egress path degradation (502s). Pager duty notified. https://internal.incidents/INC-5001 :rotating_light:

ashley (support): Customer A (acct 789) called at 13:50 — they can reproduce from their side, getting intermittent 502 then long hang. Provided headers and trace-id. Asking for credits and ETA.

lee (platform): Quick checks: model routing shows many hosts failing TLS handshake to upstream provider IPs, then gateway -> 502. Could be ECMP asymmetry or provider-side microbursts. Packet capture sampled shows duplicate ACKs and window reductions.

sam (product): Customer-facing note: can we offer immediate credits? Also need ETA for mitigation. Happy to draft message, need technical cause.

maria (oncall-sre): @lee can you dump p99/p95 latency + packet loss on egress -> provider-X for the last 10m and paste graph? Also run curl repro from jumpbox.

lee (platform): Quick metrics: p95 token-latency up 3.4x, p99 up 5.8x for eu-west2. Network probe to provider-X: 1.8% packet loss, 12% retransmit rate over 60s window. Link: https://dashboards/egress/eu-west2?range=10m

kai (sre): Ran a curl repro from eu-west2-jump:

```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
* Connected to api.redwood.ai (10.2.3.4) port 443 (#0)\n> POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1\n> ...\n< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway\n< content-type: application/json\n< x-trace-id: trace-0a1b2c3d\n{ "error": "upstream reset: connection reset by peer" }
```

kai (sre): Logs show repeated TLS handshake timeouts with provider peer, then connection reset. Traceroute suggests asymmetry after our egress edge -> provider ASN 64500 hop 4-5.

nate (infra): Looks like a BGP flap from provider-X's edges around that time (we're seeing withdrawals and re-announces for our prefixes). Might explain ECMP path flips and retransmits. I'm opening a ticket with Provider-X NOC.

lee (platform): Short-term mitigation options: 1) enable routing fallback to eu-west1 for high-retry customers 2) route certain traffic via alternate provider 3) scale up internal egress queue to absorb bursts (careful on latency). I can flip policy 1 and 2 as an emergency config.

maria (oncall-sre): Do it. @lee enable fallback 1 for accounts with >5% error rate and toggle overflow to alt-provider. Post commands you run so support can reference.

lee (platform): Flipped canary: set routing.policy.eu-west2.fallback=eu-west1 for flagged customers. Applied at 14:03 UTC. Command: `infractl route update --region eu-west2 --fallback eu-west1 --selector "error_rate>0.05"`

devops-bot: Change applied by lee at 5001235073. Rolling config to edges.

ashley (support): Notified Customer A that we're rerouting their requests and investigating. They confirmed reduced 502s after 14:06. Provided temporary credits.

sam (product): Thanks. Can we quantify the impact and confirm whether billing adjustments are needed across other affected customers?

nate (infra): Provider-X NOC responded: seeing intermittent microbursts on egress due to misconfigured queuing; they're rolling a fix, ETA ~2h. We'll keep fallback for the next 60m then reassess.

kai (sre): Continued monitoring: p99 latency trending down, packet loss to provider-X dropped to 0.4% after reroute. Keeping an eye on auth error spikes.

maria (oncall-sre): Next steps: 1) Keep fallback active until provider confirms full fix 2) Postmortem draft + timeline 3) Customer communication + credits log. Assigning owners: postmortem @maria, customer comms @ashley, provider follow-up @nate.

ashley (support): Got it. I'll compile customer list and send emails.

lee (platform): Will also add a routing-health alert to detect provider egress microbursts (packet_loss>1% and tls-handshake-timeouts>5/min) so we auto-failover next time.

maria (oncall-sre): Closing triage in this thread for now — monitoring open. If anyone sees a regression post-fix, ping immediately. :white_check_mark:
